status: FROZEN before the calibration TEST split is opened (research/07_e005a_measurement.md §7)
description: delete-one-group jackknife bias-corrected plug-in of the reward-level geometry (A^2, alpha, C^2)

selection.rule: research/07_e005a_measurement.md §7 (M_I, m = 8, N_ref = 256, lexicographic with tolerances)

preprocessing.unit: group-level RLOO contributions gamma_k (gold G, paired difference e = V - G), n = N / m groups
preprocessing.whitening: x~ = M^1/2 gamma with the metric estimated from an independent unlabeled batch of N rollouts

metric.fisher: empirical score second moment of the unlabeled rollouts (fisher_hat); W = M^1/2 (metric_sqrt)

A_near_zero_rule: jackknife A^2 <= 0 -> alpha undefined (NaN) and C^2 := jackknife Q (E002/E004 convention)
null_test: reject C = 0 iff C^2 - 1.645 SE > 0 (one-sided, nominal 0.05)
test_rules: research/07_e005a_measurement.md §8 (solved: SDB <= 0.5, null FPR in [0.02, 0.10] for >= 90% of nulls, Spearman >= 0.8; practical: + small-dose power >= 0.8; PROCEED iff min practical budget <= 1024)
